title: Source-described textual fragment or quotation passage
description: An intellectual portion or a particular quoting passage, not a physical fragment, exact transcription, editorial number, source anchor or Claim. Membership, preservation and containing-object relations remain separately grounded assertions.

fragment_account.description: The textual portion identified by this research, including uncertain or disputed extent.

boundary_basis.description: The criterion distinguishing this fragment. An editorial designation locates a proposal; it does not establish original boundaries, completeness or textual identity.

quotation_account.description: The particular passage reported as quoting another text, with quotation/paraphrase or authenticity uncertainty where needed. Not the general act of citing a work.

location_account.description: The source-reported position and boundary limits of this quoting passage. A citation is not an exact resolved anchor or an inspected manuscript.
